answer: The wander edge is written down both ways, so a closed ring of 60 clones produces a signature the raven analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Anyone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, so that doing work rather than printing keys, and the copper settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
